title: Change price: not a price point
summary: The Change price dialog with $3.95 typed: the field is invalid and says Apple has no $3.95 price point, offering the nearest two ($3.99 and $3.49) as one-click fixes; the per-store rows wait for a valid price, and Change price on 2 stores stays disabled while the field is invalid and the app name isn't typed.
compare: Validation is inline and immediate: the field turns invalid, the hint is replaced by the error (what's wrong and the fix), and the nearest price points are buttons that fill the field. Zero, empty and non-numbers get the same treatment ('Enter a price, such as $3.99').
The per-store rows show what they will show once the price is valid, muted; no conversions are computed from an invalid price.
The typed confirmation is empty, with the app name as placeholder; the confirm button is disabled (aria-disabled) until both the price is valid and the typed word matches Diceroll exactly.
Phone: the same bottom sheet as commerce.offer-price; the two fix buttons sit under the error.

findings.issue: Dialog title and close misaligned; two icon tile sizes; reassurance copy far from the price; confirm label on two lines; four sample currencies.
findings.resolution: Title and close share a 32px row; one 24px tile; 'Players who already bought Dice skins keep it' sits under the price field; the confirm label is one line with the product name as a mono chip; two sample currencies.

findings.issue: Drop the typed confirmation for price changes.
findings.resolution: declined: The consolidation plan (2.7) requires a typed confirmation for store price changes; an owner decision.
